name: Official NFL injury report
what_it_publishes: Player, position, injury description, practice status, game status, per club, per fixture, with kickoff time and network.
limits: Publishes only clubs playing that week. Carries no clock time of publication, no depth order, no snap counts and no inactive list. Past weeks are reachable through a selector but were not captured.

name: Official NFL transactions (trades)
what_it_publishes: From club, to club, date, player and transaction type for 12 trades.
limits: Dates are MM/DD with no year; the year comes from the page's own month selector. Only the trades tab was read.

name: Official NFL reserve list
what_it_publishes: Club, date, player and transaction type for 25 Reserve/Injured moves.
limits: One month only. Other transaction tabs (signings, waivers, terminations, other) were not read.

name: Official NFL schedule, Week 10 2026
what_it_publishes: Final scores for 12 of 14 games, kickoff times, networks, bye clubs and the Munich international-game designation.
limits: The two games that had not kicked off show no score. No venue field on the listing; venue appears only in a link parameter.

name: Official NFL schedule, Week 11 2026
what_it_publishes: 13 fixtures with date, kickoff time and network; 6 bye clubs; the Mexico City international-game designation; flexible-scheduling notes for Weeks 16 to 18.
limits: No venue field on the listing. The flexible-scheduling note carries no publication date.

name: Official NFL game centre
what_it_publishes: Game Info block with Location and Stadium; team records; season team statistics; team leaders; a short injury list per club.
limits: Only one game centre was read. Whether roof status and surface are published there is untested, which is probe P05.

name: NFL.com Terms and Conditions
scope_read: Section 1 (Intellectual Property), subsection 1.3 (Permitted Uses), updated 16 May 2024.
what_it_publishes: The permitted uses of the Services, including the prohibition on systematic retrieval.
limits: Only section 1.3 was read in full for this finding. Nothing here is legal advice, and this desk does not claim to interpret the rest of the agreement.
